_comment: Seed data for the Pathways builder (vortex/wall/src/pages/clinic/pathways). Flat JSON stand-in for now — migrate to a real store later. Each pathway's first node is always the fixed entry point: shape `{ "family": "entry" }` with no `type`/`subfamily` and `when: null` — it's the trigger that starts the pathway, not one of the draggable call/message/visit shapes, so it's excluded from shapeTypes.json's catalog, always renders the bell glyph, can't be reordered or removed, and has no `when` of its own (nothing precedes it to time itself against). Every later node's shape is identified by a family (call | message | visit, matching the three tray shapes: circle | rightward parallelogram | square) plus an exact type within that family — the distinct types actually used here, plus their default `when`, are catalogued in shapeTypes.json. A `type` of null means the exact type hasn't been decided yet (rendered as "?"). `when` is a dropdown, not free text: kind is 'asap' (fires right after the previous step), 'when_scheduled' (fires at whatever time was booked for it — no extra fields), or 'proactive', which adds amount/unit/direction/referenceNode to mean "<amount> <unit> <direction> node<referenceNode>" (e.g. amount 2, unit days, direction before, referenceNode 4 = "2 days before node 4"). Node numbers are just each node's 1-based position in its pathway's `nodes` array (the entry point is always node 1, just not labelled as one on screen) — not a stored id — so they track the array unless a node is reordered or removed.
